outline: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of time series analysis and process control techniques, with an emphasis on coding and conducting experiments, such as verifying results from research papers. Students will learn to analyze time-dependent data and apply various forecasting and process monitoring methods. Key topics include time series preprocessing, regression analysis, ARIMA models, and advanced techniques such as statistical process control, CUSUM, EWMA, and multivariate monitoring. The course also covers real-time contrasts and includes paper reading and presentations to explore contemporary applications in time series analysis and process control. Basic programming skills is expected.
